title: React Form Contract
description: Structural requirements for all compiled React forms

rules.title: Loading State
rules.description: Form must track a loading/submitting state (isSubmitting, isPending, or isLoading boolean)

rules.title: Submit Button Disabled During Submission
rules.description: Submit button must be disabled while loading/submitting to prevent double-submit

rules.title: Per-Field Error Display
rules.description: Each field's validation error must be displayed adjacent to that field, not only in a global error banner

rules.title: Accessible Labels
rules.description: Every input, select, and textarea must have an associated <label htmlFor> or aria-label

rules.title: Native Form Element
rules.description: Form must use a <form> element with onSubmit — not a <div> with onClick

rules.title: Zod Validation
rules.description: Form validation must use zodResolver from @hookform/resolvers/zod — no manual validate functions

rules.title: Submit Route Called
rules.description: onSubmit must invoke the declared submitRoute — calling fetch/axios/api directly without the route path is a violation

rules.title: Error Reset on Resubmit
rules.description: Form errors must be clearable — user can fix errors and resubmit without stale error state
